2609.26388.title: On the Lexical Superstition of Large Language Models for Code Comprehension: Re-evaluation on Code of Low Lexical Quality
2609.26388.paper_summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have made them widely used for code-related tasks. Identifier names are statistically informative in naturally occurring code, but their information is not always reliable. We investigate whether current LLMs assign disproportionate weight to lexical cues when renaming preserves program structure. We introduce Face/Off, a semantics-preserving identifier-renaming framework, and evaluate progressive naming conditions across multiple models and code-comprehension tasks. Within this framework, lexical overemphasis is pervasive across the evaluated models and primary tasks: performance generally decreases as identifier information is removed or made misleading, and outputs are often directed toward the meanings suggested by misleading names. The pattern persists under representative prompt- and fine-tuning-based interventions, suggesting that lexical overemphasis is an entrenched problem. A type-inference control confirms a boundary: naming effects are smaller when the answer is locally recoverable without the target name. These results do not imply that identifiers are unhelpful; rather, they reveal a systematic vulnerability in how current LLMs balance lexical cues against program structure. Our findings motivate evaluations and modeling methods that preserve the benefits of natural code regularities while keeping conclusions grounded in accurate, formalized code semantics.
2609.26388.paper_summary_zh: 最近在大型語言模型（LLMs）方面的進展使其在與代碼相關的任務中得到廣泛應用。標識符名稱在自然出現的代碼中具有統計信息，但其信息並不總是可靠。我們調查當重命名保持程序結構時，當前的LLMs是否對詞彙線索賦予不成比例的權重。我們引入了Face/Off，一個保持語義的標識符重命名框架，並在多個模型和代碼理解任務中評估漸進式命名條件。在這個框架內，詞彙過度強調在評估的模型和主要任務中普遍存在：當標識符信息被移除或變得誤導時，性能通常會下降，而輸出往往朝向誤導名稱所暗示的意義。這一模式在代表性的提示和微調干預下持續存在，這表明詞彙過度強調是一個根深蒂固的問題。一個類型推斷控制確認了一個邊界：當答案可以在不使用目標名稱的情況下局部恢復時，命名效果較小。這些結果並不意味著標識符無用；相反，它們揭示了當前LLMs在平衡詞彙線索與程序結構方面的系統性脆弱性。我們的發現促使評估和建模方法的發展，這些方法在保持自然代碼規律的好處的同時，讓結論基於準確的、形式化的代碼語義。
